Prerequisite(s): —

Benefit: The psychic can enter a deep meditation, blocking out visual and auditory stimuli and allowing her to concentrate on a single problem, philosophical issue, or memory. This trance lasts 1d6 rounds, during which time she can only take move actions. During this period, she gains a bonus equal to her psychic level on all saves against gaze attacks. When she comes out of her trance, she may make a single Intelligence-based skill check as if she had taken 20. She may enter her focused trance a number of times per day equal to her Intelligence modifier.
